contracts.protection_obligation: Agent-invoked mutating/destructive filesystem tools registered with requires_approval=True (write_file, edit_file, safe_delete_file, safe_delete_directory, download_file) must not execute their filesystem effect unless a recorded user approval in approval_state (state field pending_approval) covers the tool call; unapproved protected calls must be denied with ACCESS_DENIED before any tool execution. (Merges the first- and second-phase reviewer obligations, which describe the same approval gate.)
scope_limits: Gate is active only when config.enable_approvals is truthy: _tool_requires_approval returns False and _tool_call_is_approved returns True when it is disabled (core/nodes.py 119-123, 915-917).
The approval/tools nodes and this gate are only wired when tools_enabled = bool(tools) and config.model_supports_tools (agent.py 64, 78-80, 122-127).
Approval state is the per-turn state field pending_approval and is reset to None after the tools node returns (core/nodes.py 785-796); supplied source shows no durable approval store.
In an approved approval_state with an empty tool_call_ids set, every protected call id is treated as approved (core/nodes.py 922-923).
Decision parsing accepts bool True, a dict approved flag, or action strings approve/approved/yes/y; any other truthy decision falls back to bool(decision) as approved (core/nodes.py 703-711).
Parallel execution is reserved for all-read-only batches; mutating/destructive calls keep sequential execution (core/nodes.py 47-67, 798-802), which does not alter the gate itself.
download_file is additionally flagged networked (tools/tool_registry.py 109-116); its network-fetch side is outside this file-stratum contract.
